title: 2026 TCS New York City Marathon event page
claims: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is listed for Sunday 1 November 2026 at 8:00 AM in New York City, with the Distance field reading "Marathon" rather than a numeric 26.2 miles.
The page links to an "Official Race Results" section with a View Results link.
Runners cannot request a wave change at the Expo, and corral changes will not be considered.
A faster marathon result for wave placement must be submitted by 8 September 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET, from an in-person certified marathon run between 26 February and 7 September 2026.
The race is a 9+1 program qualifier.
Entry fees are non-refundable; a 2026 entrant may cancel and earn non-complimentary guaranteed entry to the 2027 race, but must claim it and pay the 2027 fees.
Entry fees may not be deferred or transferred.
Marathon Monday at the Pavilion presented by Mastercard offers medal engraving, recovery, shopping and a return to the finish area.
The page says the TCS New York City Marathon has broken the world record for the largest marathon for the second consecutive year.
The page lists prize money, wave starts, charity spots and Team for Climate among the event categories.
The page says all event information is subject to change and directs readers to nyrr.org/tcsnycmarathon.
The page describes the event as inclusive and accessible, with athletes from the first to the final finisher running the same course on the same day.
